source.title: Primary prophylaxis for venous thromboembolism in ambulatory cancer patients receiving chemotherapy.

scope: Read exact 168-page Cochrane secondary review, including methods, summaries, included/excluded study characteristics, analyses/forest plots, appendices and disclosures. Extract bounded aspirin-related myeloma prophylaxis evidence and its actual compared interventions/population/outcomes/time windows plus source-reported certainty/limitations; broad anticoagulant or all-cancer pooled findings are CONTEXT, never aspirin efficacy. Preserve VTE prevention versus established disease/tumor treatment, aspirin versus LMWH/VKA comparators, RCT versus reports, total review study N versus specific comparison N, event numerators/denominators and direction/CI/heterogeneity. Review is secondary: zero newly verified primary trials/participants from citations alone.
sourcePolicy: Closed exact Reed PDF/index only; no source acquisition. Source-stated original trial findings remain secondhand unless a separate prospective primary-source packet is actually read. No silent substitution from abstract/book/current guidance or incomplete historical extraction. All 168 pages must be inspected before full-source read claim; reading can be chunked with honest progress.
schema: SCHEMA.json plus pinned15Q67typedfields; source-native physical and printed locators; review outcomes/certainty and editorial grading kept separate
downstream: Private unapplied G-DRUG-D13 aspirin/G-CONDITION-C21 if actual IDs verified before mapping; prophylaxis context distinct from tumor efficacy and clinical recommendation. No grade or public change.
verification: Own full168pages, consequential aspirin/myeloma forest plots/tables visually, exact source/index/GP/dependencies, meaningful secondhand/comparator/denominator/missingness guards and independent root bounded audit. Fullfield/science/human/release remain0.
